title: ASR Registry Manifest (registry.json)
description: The machine-owned root manifest of a registry. It is a REGENERABLE projection of the source profiles plus hand-set registry metadata (title, defaults, contact): `authority regen` rebuilds sections, the source index, counts, and integrity atomically, and doing so is also the crash-recovery move. Tools resolve objects through `sections` and the source index — never by hard-coding paths. The manifest is self-describing: `readme` and `rules_note` teach a tool that has never heard of ASR what the folder is.

registry_id.description: Opaque nonce id minted at init; format-checked but not content-addressed (a registry has no canonical content to key on).

asr_spec_version.description: Semver of the ASR spec this registry conforms to. A reader for 0.x MUST accept a 0.y registry for any y ≥ x within the same major line.

readme.description: One self-describing paragraph for tools and humans that arrive without context.

rules_note.description: Pointer to the governing spec section, e.g. "spec/00-overview.md".

defaults.description: Registry-wide operational defaults; access methods may override per-method.

verification_window_days.description: Days a verified state stays fresh before deriving to stale. Default 90. Deliberately independent of content update_cadence — access stability and content rhythm are different clocks.

politeness_delay_ms.description: Minimum delay between consecutive requests to the same host. Default 1000.

user_agent_contact.description: Contact URL or mailto appended to the probe/fetch User-Agent so operators can reach the registry owner.

sections.description: Authoritative resolution table from logical section to physical path, relative to the registry root. A value ending in / is a directory.

sources.description: The source index: one entry per profile, regenerated from the profiles themselves (counts and states here are a cache; the profiles are truth).

schema_hash.description: sha256: + sha256 of the JCS serialization of {filename: sha256(file)} over schemas/*.json + vocab/vocab.json, so readers can detect schema skew within a minor version.
